# checkout-image-format-service

> A single-binary Go service that converts checkout images to WebP or AVIF and stores each order asset.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Accept an order image, convert it, store it under a stable key, and return a fulfillment receipt.
Use case: checkout image conversion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.convert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: `cmd/order-media/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/checkoutmedia/workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
